subsystems.name: Radio-frequency sensing front end
subsystems.role: detects the tiny body movements caused by breathing and heartbeat, without any contact.

subsystems.name: Thermal sensing
subsystems.role: reads skin and breath temperature patterns, and confirms a person is present.

subsystems.name: Vital-sign extraction
subsystems.role: turns noisy radio and thermal signals into respiration and heart rates.

subsystems.name: Sensor fusion
subsystems.role: combines the two modalities so that one covers the other's blind spots.

subsystems.name: Edge compute and privacy layer
subsystems.role: keeps raw data in the home and outputs only health parameters.

subsystems.name: Alerts and care integration
subsystems.role: escalates anomalies to the household or a carer.

buildSteps.title: Pick the room and sensor positions
buildSteps.detail: Radio sensing needs the person within range of the antennas and a reasonably stable multipath environment; thermal needs line of sight to the face or chest.

buildSteps.title: Baseline the empty room
buildSteps.detail: The system records how radio waves bounce off walls and furniture with nobody present, so those echoes can be subtracted.

buildSteps.title: Collect labelled data
buildSteps.detail: Volunteers lie or sit in view while a reference method — a chest strap or ECG — records true respiration and heart rate, building a training set.

buildSteps.title: Train the separation model
buildSteps.detail: Breathing sits near 0.2–0.3 Hz and heartbeat near 1–1.5 Hz; the model must pull the weaker heartbeat signal out of chest movement, posture shifts and speech.

buildSteps.title: Add thermal channels
buildSteps.detail: Breath-related temperature changes near the nostrils give a second respiration estimate, and skin temperature adds a coarse thermal trend.

buildSteps.title: Fuse and score confidence
buildSteps.detail: The system reports a reading only when radio and thermal agree and motion is low; otherwise it flags the measurement as unusable.

buildSteps.title: Validate against clinical reference
buildSteps.detail: Accuracy is checked across age, body size, clothing and sleep position, which is what regulators require before health claims are made.

buildSteps.title: Deploy with privacy by design
buildSteps.detail: Only derived numbers leave the device; raw signals and thermal frames are processed and discarded locally.

prerequisites.tech: Wi-Fi channel-state-information access on cheap chipsets
prerequisites.why: sensing works best where firmware exposes fine-grained channel data, which consumer hardware does not always allow.
these already sit in consumer devices, though at low resolution and modest thermal sensitivity.

prerequisites.tech: Machine-learning models robust to real rooms
prerequisites.why: laboratory accuracy falls sharply with movement, multiple people and unusual furniture layouts.
wellness readings are easy to ship; trusted diagnosis requires evidence and regulation.

prerequisites.tech: On-device compute with strong privacy controls
prerequisites.why: contactless sensing of health in the home is only acceptable if raw data never leaves it.

pathway.milestone: radio-based presence, sleep and fall detection in smart-home devices
pathway.unlocks: contactless awareness without cameras or wearables.

pathway.milestone: wellness-grade respiration and heart-rate trends validated in the home
pathway.unlocks: early warning of deterioration for older or chronically ill people.

pathway.milestone: regulatory clearance for specific clinical uses such as sleep apnoea screening
pathway.unlocks: use in telehealth and remote care programmes.

pathway.milestone: multi-room, multi-person monitoring fused with clinical records
pathway.unlocks: continuous passive care that reduces hospital admissions — provided accuracy, bias and privacy are shown to hold up.
